sample.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
sample.text: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
sample.summary: اكتشفت ثغرة في Apache Axis تسمح لصادر خارجي غير مصادق بتنفيذ كود مُخصص عبر رسالة SOAP مُعدّلة تؤدي إلى تحميل وتهيئة فئة محددة من قبل المهاجم. يُنصح المستخدمين بوقف استخدام المنتج المتأثر وتحوّل إلى إصدار مدعوم.

sample.text: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation. Successful exploitation requires a specific combination of conditions to be met, which reduces the likelihood of a successful attack.
